newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: RESEARCH ALERT - Electricidad downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Electricidad downgraded to hold.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Securities (USA) Inc said it had downgraded its recommendation on Venezuelan electric utility Electricidad de Caracas to hold from buy.
Credit Lyonnais said the downgrade of the Caracas Stock Exchange's bellwether stock was based on:

- "...we estimate that EDC's shares are fully valued, since they trade at 7.7 percent premium to our extremely optimistic NAV calculation. Thus, we believe that all we can expect to hear about the company in the future is bad news."
- "After recent tariff adjustments EDC is entering a period of high profitability, which we expect to be short-lived."
- Potential for growth in consumption is limited "since the company's average consumption rate per residential customer is 74 percent higher than those of its Latin American peers."
